audit_result.proof_trace: The `getMonthlyAttendance` server action uses `createSupabaseAdminClient()` (service-role key) which bypasses the RLS policy `auth.uid() = user_id` on `attendance.attendances`, and accepts an arbitrary `userId` parameter with no check that the calling user owns that ID. The RLS policy (migration `0001_create_attendance_schema.sql` line 45) correctly restricts direct authenticated queries, but the admin client circumvents it entirely, leaving the server action as an unguarded cross-user read path.
audit_result.attack_scenario: An authenticated attacker invokes the exported `'use server'` action `getMonthlyAttendance` via a direct HTTP POST with a victim's Supabase UUID as `userId`; the admin client returns the victim's full monthly attendance records (dates, in/out status) without any authorization failure.

PROP-e5782b58-pre-008.text: Non-admin users must only access their own attendance records; IDOR on user_id must be prevented.
PROP-e5782b58-pre-008.assertion: forall query(user, target_user_id): user.is_admin == false => target_user_id == user.id
